intro.title: Integrated Lubricants & Greases Manufacturer
intro.p1: Cerotd (Shandong) Lubrication Technology Co., Ltd. is an integrated manufacturer of lubricating oils and greases covering R&D, production, sales, technical training and logistics distribution, with a strong presence in the domestic market. Located in Jining, Shandong — the hometown of Confucius and Mencius — the company is based in the Jibei New Material Industrial Park and has grown into a rising force there.
intro.p2: With 20 years of development, the company occupies 28,000 square meters and has a total investment of RMB 89 million. It now offers 100+ products with annual production capacity of more than 100,000 tons, covering industrial oils, automotive oils, specialty oils, construction-machinery lubricants and automotive care products. Cerotd has built a network of 1,000+ distributors across 20+ provinces, municipalities and autonomous regions in China, with annual production and sales reaching up to 150,000 tons.
intro.p3: We uphold the brand philosophy of being professional, dedicated and focused; pursue the vision of “helping others succeed so we can succeed”; and follow the corporate spirit of “pursuing ultimate detail to deliver perfect results,” providing more efficient, environmentally friendly and energy-saving lubrication solutions for customers worldwide.

lines.title: Core product lines
lines.subtitle: Automotive, industrial and specialty lubricants — grades and packaging can be matched to your duty cycle.

item1.name: Automotive engine oils
item1.desc: Premium base oils and advanced additive packages in full synthetic, semi-synthetic and mineral grades, with strong shear stability and low-temperature fluidity.

item2.name: Heavy-duty diesel engine oils
item2.desc: Built for severe duty and extended drain intervals, with strong detergency, oxidation stability, anti-wear protection and soot control.

item3.name: Heavy-duty gear oils
item3.desc: Synthetic base oils with advanced EP/anti-wear additives for high load-carrying capacity and pitting resistance.

item4.name: Anti-wear hydraulic oils
item4.desc: High VI refined base oils with efficient additive systems for stable performance under high pressure, speed and temperature.

item5.name: Antifreeze / coolant
item5.desc: High-purity ethylene glycol with advanced corrosion inhibitors for freeze, boil, corrosion and scale protection.

item6.name: Greases
item6.desc: Premium base oils and advanced thickeners with high-temperature stability, load capacity, water resistance and lasting lubrication.

item7.name: Industrial oils
item7.desc: Anti-wear/EP protection, rust prevention, demulsibility and foam control for a wide range of industrial machinery.
